title: 第1章 洞窟新生第2章 众神的成长
lines: 绝对的黑暗笼罩着一切。
那是连时光都仿佛凝固的幽深，是万物归于寂静的虚无之境。
在这片连声音都被吞噬的领域里，唯有生命最原始的脉动，某种轻浅呼吸声证明着某个存在的苏醒。
他睁开了眼睛。
映入眼帘的是一片漆黑死寂的洞窟。
岩壁呈现出某种非自然的平滑，像是被巨大脏器内壁包裹形成的腔室，却又诡异地呈现出岩石的质地。
四下寂静无声，连滴水穿石的细微声响都不存在，唯有他自己呼吸时气流通过鼻腔的微弱声音。
但诡异的是，明明身处于如此幽暗的洞穴，视野中的一切却清晰可见。
那些岩壁的纹理、地面上细微的凹凸、远处洞道曲折的轮廓，所有细节都以一种超越常理的方式呈现在他眼中，仿佛黑暗本身在为他让路，又仿佛他的视觉早已脱离了凡俗的束缚。
这种极端的反差让他产生了强烈的违和感。
低语在寂静中回荡。他试图撑起身体，手掌按在冰冷的地面上，那触感不像是岩石，更像是某种凝固有机物。
记忆如碎片般涌现。
最后的片段停留在蔚蓝的海水中。
阳光透过海面洒下摇曳的光斑，鱼群在珊瑚丛中穿梭，然后......窒息感袭来，海水灌入肺部，意识沉入黑暗。
他应该已经死了。
纷乱的思绪还未压下，一阵规律的脚步声便由远及近，打破了这片寂静。
踏、踏、踏。
脚步声不疾不徐，在这完全封闭的空间中产生轻微的回响。来者可能是这陌生环境中唯一的线索，甚至是救命稻草，又或者是某种未知的威胁。
他绷紧身体，维持着戒备的姿态，朝声音来源望去。肌肉记忆让他本能地摆出了格斗架势，那是多年练习留下的烙印，即便意识尚未完全清醒，身体已经做好了应对危险的准备。
人影从洞道深处浮现。
那是一名男子，或者说，从外貌上看更接近少年与青年之间的过渡阶段。
黑发如墨垂至肩头，眼眸是比黑暗更深的漆黑，周身散发着一丝与年龄不符的阴郁气息。
他的身材魁梧，肩宽背阔，裹在身上的简陋衣袍下隐约可见结实的肌肉线条。
见对方手中没有武器，他心下稍安。他自忖好歹也是练了多年格斗技的练家子，只要不是碰上什么持械的职业选手，脱身应该不成问题。
这个判断基于他作为凡人的经验，却尚未意识到，此刻他所处的世界，早已不是那个可以用常理揣度的领域了。
他屏息凝神地盯着对方，只见那黑发男子在几步之外停下，缓缓开口：
“汝终于醒了，吾兄弟。吾还以为你被父亲大人杀掉后才进来的呢。”
停顿片刻，那黑发男子又补充道：“汝闭着眼睛一脸安详的样子，睡得可真够沉的。”
这番话让人彻底懵了。
这都哪儿跟哪儿啊？什么父亲？什么杀？前一秒还在海水里挣扎，怎么突然就跳戏到家庭伦理剧了？
他的大脑飞速运转，试图从这荒谬的对话中理出逻辑。
黑发少年观察着他的反应，咂了下嘴，那仿佛中二般的语气也垮掉了一些：
“啧，看来你还没弄明白状况。我们是被父亲克洛诺斯吞进了肚子，现在，就在他肚子里活着呢。”
“克洛诺斯？！”
这个名字如同钥匙，瞬间打开了他记忆的某个角落。
‘希腊神话......泰坦神王......乌拉诺斯与盖亚之子......吞食子女......’
知识碎片在意识中拼凑。
克洛诺斯，第二代神王，因恐惧预言中将被自己的子女推翻，于是在每个孩子诞生时就将他们吞入腹中。
这个神话故事他曾在学生时代读过，那时只觉得是荒诞的传说，从未想过有一天会以这种方式亲身体验。
“哦？眼神变了，汝是想起来了吗？想起被生吞时的记忆了？”黑发少年观察着他的反应，又端起了架子。
“倒也正常，吾等身为神裔，天生不凡。当然，吾也只见过包括汝在内的三名同类便是了。”
content_en:
Absolute darkness enveloped everything.
It was a depth where even time seemed to have frozen, a realm of nothingness where everything returned to silence.
In this realm where even sound has been swallowed up, there is only the most primitive pulse of life, some kind of light breathing, which proves the awakening of a certain existence.
He opened his eyes.
What came into view was a dark and silent cave.
The rock wall showed some unnatural smoothness, like a chamber formed by the inner wall of a huge organ, but it also strangely presented the texture of rock.
There was silence everywhere, not even the slightest sound of water dripping through the stone. There was only the faint sound of air flowing through his nose when he breathed.
But the strange thing is that even though he is in such a dark cave, everything in his field of vision is clearly visible.
The texture of the rock walls, the subtle concavities and convexities on the ground, the zigzag outline of the cave in the distance, all details were presented to his eyes in a way that transcended common sense, as if the darkness itself was making way for him, and as if his vision had long been freed from the shackles of the mundane.
This extreme contrast gave him a strong sense of disobedience.
"What's going on..."
Whispers echoed in the silence. He tried to prop up his body and pressed his palms on the cold ground. The touch was not like rocks, but more like some solid organic matter.
Memories emerge in fragments.
The final fragment lingers in the blue waters.
The sun casts swaying spots of light through the sea surface, fishes shuttle among the corals, and then...a feeling of suffocation came over, the seawater poured into the lungs, and the consciousness sank into darkness.
He should be dead.
Before the chaotic thoughts could be suppressed, a regular sound of footsteps came from far away, breaking the silence.
Tread, step, step.
The footsteps were neither fast nor slow, producing a slight echo in this completely enclosed space. The visitor may be the only clue in this strange environment, or even a life-saving straw, or it may be some unknown threat.
He tensed his body, maintained a alert posture, and looked towards the source of the sound. Muscle memory allowed him to instinctively assume a fighting stance, which was the imprint left by years of practice. Even if his consciousness was not fully awake, his body was already prepared to deal with danger.
A figure emerged from the depths of the cave.
He was a man, or, in appearance, closer to the transitional stage between a boy and a young man.
His black hair hangs down to his shoulders like ink, his eyes are darker than the darkness, and his whole body exudes a gloomy aura that is inconsistent with his age.
He was tall and tall, with broad shoulders and a broad back, and his strong muscle lines were faintly visible under the simple robe wrapped around him.
Seeing that the opponent had no weapons in his hands, he felt a little relieved. He thought to himself that he was a martial artist who had practiced fighting skills for many years. As long as he didn't encounter any professional players armed with weapons, escaping shouldn't be a problem.
This judgment is based on his experience as a mortal, but he has not yet realized that the world he is in at this moment is no longer a realm that can be speculated with common sense.
He stared at the other person with bated breath, only to see the black-haired man stop a few steps away and speak slowly:
"You finally woke up, my brother. I thought you came in after being killed by your father."
After a pause, the black-haired man added: "You closed your eyes and looked peaceful. You were sleeping very deeply."
These words left people completely confused.
Where is this going? What father? What to kill? He was struggling in the sea a second ago, why did he suddenly jump into a family ethics drama?
His mind was racing, trying to make sense of the absurd conversation.
The black-haired boy observed his reaction, smacked his lips, and his tone as if he was a fool also weakened a little:
"Tsk, it seems you haven't figured out the situation yet. We were swallowed by our father Cronus, and now we are alive in his belly."
"Cronus?!"
This name was like a key, instantly opening a corner of his memory.
'Greek mythology...the Titan king...the son of Uranus and Gaia...devouring children...'
Fragments of knowledge are pieced together in consciousness.
Cronus, the second generation god-king, feared that he would be overthrown by his children in the prophecy, so he swallowed each of his children as they were born.
He had read this mythical story when he was a student. At that time, he only thought it was a ridiculous legend. He never thought that one day he would experience it personally in this way.
"Oh? Your eyes have changed. Have you remembered? Remembered the memory of being swallowed alive?" The black-haired boy observed his reaction and put on airs again.
"That's normal. As descendants of gods, we are born extraordinary. Of course, I have only seen three of the same kind, including you."
title_en: Chapter 1 The Rebirth of the Cave Chapter 2 The Growth of the Gods
